callerLines: My date of birth is March 14th, 1990.
Yes please, I'd like to refill my Concerta.
Yes, that's right. Please order it.
I've had some mild headaches in the afternoon.
spoken: This is Maple Street Pharmacy calling for Sam Rivera. To continue, I'll send a code to this phone.
Thank you.
Before I can check the code, I need to confirm your date of birth.
Could you tell me your date of birth, with the day, month and year?
A pharmacist will check it first, and I'll confirm once it's approved.
I'm calling because you asked us to ring you before your medication runs out.
I can look at your Concerta prescription and tell you how many refills are left and whether it can be refilled today.
Would you like me to do that?
Good news, your Concerta can be refilled today.
You have 2 refills left.
Here are the details before I order it.
The medicine is Concerta, 36 milligrams tablets.
Your plan pays $41.20, and you pay $4.10.
Shall I go ahead and request this refill?
Please say yes or no.
Your refill request has been sent.
A pharmacist will check it first, and I'll confirm once it's approved.
Your order number is o underscore c, zero, zero, zero, one, underscore, r x, underscore, s a m, underscore, concerta.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Since your last refill, have you noticed any side effects, or anything else?
Thanks, I've passed that to the pharmacist with your refill.
Since I can't give medical advice, the pharmacist is the right person to talk to about the headaches.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
You're welcome, Sam.
Your refill is with the pharmacist, and they will look at it soon.
Take care, and goodbye.
